purpose: Separate list of context-dependent conversion notes still awaiting individually cited lexical-example verification. Proposed examples are copied unchanged, not independently validated here.
reviewGuidance: Check each proposed word conversion against an authoritative lexical dictionary or version-pinned OpenCC phrase mapping.
Check whether a word is unchanged in traditional writing when the note gives an unchanged example.
Record the exact supporting dictionary entry URL or pinned dataset record for the validated example.
Distinguish region-specific practices (mainland / Taiwan / Hong Kong) rather than treating them as universal.
Keep Unihan association verification separate from lexical-example and 2013-standard classification verification.
sourceCaveats: A generic Unicode TR38 citation documents the Unihan property model, not the particular example used in any note.
A valid simplified/traditional character association does not prove a word conversion is correct in every region or sense.
No source evidence or examples have been changed or added during this extraction.
Other association notes not marked as outstanding are outside the scope of this file; do not infer that all of them have individually verified lexical citations.
